title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.16852v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prio

translated_title: 合规检测器究竟读取了什么？对激活探针与防护模型的审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16852v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在部署的语言模型中，法规合规监控越来越多地被用作法律和审计控制，根据涵盖数据保护、医疗保健、金融监管和平台政策的书面规则检查模型输出。这种监控只有在检测器的判断取决于所述规则而非场景的表面特征时才有意义。我们表明，这一条件在当前类别的合规检测器中不成立，我们将这种失败称为“规则盲”。删除、排列或替换主导规则，对我们测试的每个防护模型和激活探针的检测准确性没有影响，包括一个策略条件化的防护模型，它正确引用了主导条款，但当该条款被替换为允许性对应条款时，其判断几乎不变。一个专门设计的基准测试，将两条规则与两个场景交叉，使得单独任何一个都无法预测标签，在无先验的设计下确认了这种失败。
tldr: 本文发现当前合规检测器存在“规则盲”问题，即它们对规则内容的改变不敏感，仅依赖表面特征，导致监管监控失效。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that current compliance detectors suffer from "rule blindness," remaining insensitive to changes in stated rules and relying only on surface features, rendering regulatory monitoring ineffective.
